tasks.Merge Dictionaries: Write a function to merge two dictionaries as per the given requirements.

Questions.content: What happens if one of the dictionaries is empty? Is the function expected to return the other dictionary unchanged?
What happens if there are overlapping keys with different values in the dictionaries? How should the function handle such cases?
What happens if one of the dictionaries contains nested dictionaries? Should the function merge them as well, or should it treat them as separate values?

tasks.DefineFunction: Write a function to merge two dictionaries.
tasks.TestFunction: Run the defined function against provided test cases.

Questions.content: What happens if one of the dictionaries is empty? Should the function return the other dictionary as is?

What happens if both dictionaries contain the same key with different values? Should the function update the value in the merged dictionary, or should it keep one of the values (e.g., the first encountered)?
What happens if one of the dictionaries contains nested dictionaries? Should the function merge them recursively, or should it treat them as regular values in the final merged dictionary?

tasks.DefineFunction: Write a function named merge_dict that takes two dictionaries as input and returns their merged version.
tasks.TestFunction: Run the provided test cases to ensure the correctness of the function.
